richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhiwani

c: Bhiwani, in southern Haryana, has a strong sporting culture and is especially well known for producing boxers. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhiwani to schools, colleges, sports grounds, village and municipal parks, and residential colonies. The Fun Fitness range is built at our factory in Vasai, about 1,100 km away, and delivered to Haryana by road.

In a town where young people take training seriously, an open gym gets pushed harder than usual. Strength stations need to be solid, and pull-up bars need to take repeated, heavy use. The same park will usually also have older residents who walk every morning and want gentler machines. The climate is semi-arid, with very hot summers, dust storms before the monsoon and cold winter nights, so we fix machines with grouted footings and build them on galvanised frames.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment take heavy use by athletes?
items.a: Our strength stations are built on galvanised pipe frames and grouted into concrete footings. They are made for daily public use. Check the bolts regularly on a busy ground.

items.q: Do you supply village parks around Bhiwani?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road to towns and villages, and install through our team or a dealer covering north India. Send us the ground size and photos to begin.

items.q: How do dust storms affect the machines?
items.a: Fine dust settles on seats and around moving parts. Wipe the machines after a storm and keep the area around them clear of sand so pedals and footplates move freely.
